fusions.name: Herding Crack
fusions.desc: Cracks the lash across a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Rally the Herd
fusions.desc: A signal crack at the first enemy in reach deals 30 damage, and on a hit every ally strikes 20% harder for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Round Up
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 7 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Herd-Warm Hide
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 10%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
